'''Gun runner's pistols''' were a make of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were silver in color with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] patterning on and several blue lights built in. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Jendan Blyes|Blyes]], a member of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] fighting in a [[Separatist War|civil war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the Cold War owned one as part of his personal supply of weapons.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Blyes gave the gun runner's pistol to the smuggler known as [[Voidhound|Ace]] as a reward for disabling a number of [[Jammer/Legends|signal jammer]] belonging to the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] during an assault on [[Drelliad village]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gun runner's pistols are a low level weapon available in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It is available to character's of the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] class for completion of an optional quest on their starting [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. There is currently no other way to obtain it in game and so players of other classes can only acquire it through trading with [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] players currently having no way to own it.
